exam_scheme.note: The CGPSC State Service Examination comprises three stages: Preliminary Examination (2 objective papers of 200 marks each, with 1/3 negative marking), Main Examination (7 compulsory descriptive conventional papers of 200 marks each, 1,400 marks total), and Interview / Personality Test (150 marks), leading to a final merit list out of 1,550 marks.

stages.source_label: CGPSC State Service Examination Notification & Scheme

papers.paper_name: General Studies (Paper I — Part 1: India GS, Part 2: Chhattisgarh GK)
papers.negative_marking: 0.66 mark penalty (1/3rd deduction for each incorrect answer)
papers.qualifying_threshold: Merit score in Paper I determines qualification for Mains shortlist in the ratio of 1:15 of vacancies

papers.paper_name: Aptitude Test (Paper II — CSAT, Reasoning, Mental Ability, Hindi & Chhattisgarhi Language)
papers.negative_marking: 0.66 mark penalty (1/3rd deduction for each incorrect answer)
papers.qualifying_threshold: 33% minimum qualifying marks (66 out of 200) for unreserved; 23% (46 out of 200) for reserved categories

stages.source_label: CGPSC State Service Examination Scheme & Syllabus

papers.paper_name: Paper I: Language (General Hindi 100 marks, General English 50 marks, Chhattisgarhi Language 50 marks)
Paper II: Essay (Section 1: National/International Level Issues, Section 2: Chhattisgarh State Issues)
Paper III: History, Constitution and Public Administration (History of India & CG, Constitution, Public Administration)
Paper IV: Science, Technology and Environment (Physics, Chemistry, Biology, Technology & Environment)
Paper V: Economics and Geography (Economics of India & CG, Geography of India & CG)
Paper VI: Mathematical Reasoning, Philosophy and Sociology (Philosophy, Sociology, Social Scenario of CG)
Paper VII: Welfare, Development Programmes & Laws (Indian & State Welfare Legislations, Sports & International Bodies)

stages.source_label: CGPSC State Service Examination Interview Guidelines

papers.qualifying_threshold: Candidates shortlisted in 1:3 ratio of vacancies based on Mains aggregate score

financial_package.note: State Administrative Service officers (Deputy Collectors) in Chhattisgarh are remunerated under the Chhattisgarh Civil Services (Revised Pay) Rules, 2017 at Pay Matrix Level 12 (entry basic pay ₹56,100) with state dearness allowance, house rent allowance, and executive service allowances.
financial_package.pay_source_label: Chhattisgarh Civil Services (Revised Pay) Rules, 2017 & CGPSC SSE Notification
financial_package.estimate_note: Gross salary calculated from Level 12 entry basic ₹56,100 + 58% DA (₹32,538) + HRA (8%–16% depending on city tier such as Raipur or district headquarters) + vehicle/fuel allowance, medical, and administrative perks. In-hand estimate factors in standard statutory deductions including 10% NPS (Basic + DA = ₹8,864), GIS, and Professional Tax.
official_perks: Official designated residential bungalow / Type-V executive accommodation
Official government vehicle with dedicated driver and POL fuel entitlement for administrative field visits
Statutory executive magisterial powers and administrative authority under CrPC/BNSS
Comprehensive medical coverage for officer and family under Chhattisgarh State Employees Health Scheme
Mobile telephone, broadband internet reimbursement, and camp office facilities
Induction into Indian Administrative Service (IAS) cadre under State Civil Service promotion quota
